policy.law: A48-1 reference-window provenance read of W - FROZEN BEFORE ANY NETWORK ACCESS
policy.url-provenance: copied verbatim from the held A46/A47 W record - NOT retyped

why-this-window.fact: the held 1200-char window ends mid-sentence at 'that a comple...' and contains only the markers [1][2][3]; the reference LIST is rendered further down the SAME page
why-this-window.structure: MediaWiki renders the reference list as the FIRST <ol class="references"> whose <li> items are numbered in display order, so item i corresponds to the displayed marker [i]
why-this-window.no-exploration: the container and the item order are standard MediaWiki rendering; identifying them needs NO request, and no request is made to discover them

request.path: web_research.fetch(url) - the existing road (guards, kind law, body cap)
request.redirects: followed only as the road already follows them; a redirect is RECORDED, never followed to another content source by hand
request.failure-honesty: a transport failure is recorded as a failure, never as empty content

extraction.container:
the FIRST
    ...
block in the returned RAW HTML
extraction.items: split the container on <li ...>; item i (1-based) is the target of displayed marker [i]
extraction.item-text: web_research.extract(item_html, max_chars=20000, thin=0) - the EXISTING extractor; no new parser and no production change
extraction.markers: [1], [2], [3] only - no other marker is resolved in this sprint
extraction.targets: each li's id attribute is recorded VERBATIM; it is never resolved or navigated
extraction.fields: author / title / publisher / institution / date / edition / translator / URL are recorded ONLY where they literally appear in the extracted entry text
extraction.completeness: each entry is COMPLETE, PARTIAL or TRUNCATED against its own visible text - never reconstructed
extraction.class: PRIMARY (an edition/translation of the edicts themselves) / SECONDARY (scholarship about the history) / TERTIARY (reference-work summary) / UNCLASSIFIABLE - decided ONLY from the entry's own words
extraction.failure: if the container is absent or holds fewer than 3 items, each missing marker is recorded UNRESOLVED - no second request, no alternative source

preserve.body-digest: sha256 at receipt, recorded before extraction
preserve.extracted-file: the extracted reference entries recorded VERBATIM in the observation artifact
preserve.labels: every word is a FRESH LIVE observation; the A42-A47 bytes are NOT reused as a substitute

requirements.EXPLICIT-SHARED-REFERENCE: a W reference entry and a C signal name the SAME work or the SAME author/translator, visibly
requirements.EXPLICIT-RELATED-AUTHORITY: a W entry and a C signal name authorities visibly related (e.g. one quotes what the other lists) but NOT the same work/person as source
requirements.POSSIBLE-SHARED-DERIVATION: the entries suggest a common underlying source without establishing it
requirements.NO-VISIBLE-CONNECTION: no W entry names any of C's signals
requirements.UNRESOLVED: W's entry is missing/truncated, or C's signal is unnamed, so no comparison is possible

c-only-signals: Ven. S. Dhammika and 'the present rendering'
forbidden: shared author != proof all claims derive from that source
a domain difference is still not independence

ceiling.independence: A48 CANNOT promote source independence to ESTABLISHED because a bibliography became visible
ceiling.ladder: DIVERSITY-ONLY unless previously declared requirements are satisfied; A46/A47 carry over

restoration.config: NO production configuration or provider change is made; config.json sha256 recorded before and after
restoration.env: no environment variable is set or popped

acceptance.SUCCESS: all three markers resolve to verbatim entries AND the body digest is preserved
acceptance.PARTIAL: some markers resolve; the rest are recorded UNRESOLVED with the reason
acceptance.FAILED: the request fails, or the container is absent/fewer than 3 items - recorded honestly, no retry

carry-over.a47: UNCHANGED (ATTRIBUTION-CHAIN-INCOMPLETE); A48 may only IMPROVE W's chain reconstruction

prohibitions: no post-hoc rule change after seeing bytes

items.text: ↑ Seems to refer to Tamil ruler Athiyaman . [ 70 ]
↑ Kelalaputa is the Prakrit for Kerala. [ 71 ]

↑ For example, according to Hultzsch, the first line of the First Edict at Shahbazgarhi (or at Mansehra ) reads: (Ayam) Dhrama - dipi Devanapriyasa Raño likhapitu ("This Dharma-Edicts was written by King Devanampriya " Hultzsch 1925 , p. 51 This appears in the reading of Hultzsch's original rubbing of the Kharoshthi inscription of the first line of the First Edict at Shahbazgarhi .

extraction.finding: the first <ol class="references"> is a NOTES/FILETEXT group, not the main numbered reference list: its items carry ids cite_note-71, cite_note-73, cite_note-118, cite_note-119 and its first entry points back to [70]. The frozen premise 'item i is the target of marker [i]' is FALSE for this page - MediaWiki can render SEVERAL reflist groups and the notes group precedes the main list.

1.why: the frozen container's item 1 is cite_note-71 (a note back-referencing [70]), not the target of [1]

2.why: the frozen container's item 2 is cite_note-73, not the target of [2]

3.why: the frozen container's item 3 is cite_note-118, not the target of [3]
